ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the recent $90 million indictment.
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How does the recent indictment fit into the larger picture of Medicaid fraud in the state?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, and could lead to further investigations and indictments.
